column1: # The complete vocabulary of legitimate skip reasons, and what each one means.
# `.github/ci/platform-case-gate.sh` matches the reason text a skipped test
# actually printed against these patterns. A skip whose reason matches NOTHING
# here is fatal: that is how a newly-introduced skip is caught the first time it
# runs, instead of quietly shrinking the suite.
# Every skip -- tolerated or not -- is written to `skips-observed.tsv` with its
# package, case name, class and verbatim reason, so "no case silently skipped"
# is a property of the evidence and not of a promise.
#   deferred-only  legitimate only for a package `suite-plan.sh` deferred
#                  because the supplied root does not publish its artefacts.
#                  In a lane that requires a fully-serving root there are no
#                  deferred packages, so this class becomes fatal there --
#                  which is exactly what stops a candidate run from passing
#                  while a package ran without its vectors.
#   platform-control  a control or fixture the protocol/runtime defines for
#                     another platform only. This is the acceptance criteria's
#                     and the ONLY class that may hide a whole platform's
#   host-capability   the runner cannot create the artefact the case needs
#                     (symlink, hard link, reparse point, FIFO, named pipe,
#                     non-UTF-8 name, case sensitivity, mode-000 semantics).
#   root-content      the supplied conformance root publishes no such vector
#                     group. Recorded against the root's identity in the
#   root-unset        the package ran with CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT unset.
#   opt-in            an explicit developer environment variable or a probe
#   helper-process    the `go test` helper-process re-exec pattern.
# Columns are TAB separated. `regex` is an extended regular expression matched
# against the reason text, anchored nowhere -- it may match anywhere in it.
